parameters.what: retraining window after a procedure is revised
parameters.quote: When a procedure is revised, everyone trained on it is retrained within 30 days.
Review the required procedures for each role every year.

rules.statement: The Line Lead signs off a new operator on FRM-TR-02 for each required procedure.
rules.quote: A new operator works with a qualified operator until signed off on FRM-TR-02 Sign-Off Sheet

rules.topic: who tells the Training Coordinator of a revision
rules.statement: The document owner tells the Training Coordinator on the day of issue.
